preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the length of the sequence n must be between 2 and 300,000.
The sum of all n values across all test cases must not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output sequence must contain exactly n distinct integers.
All integers in the output sequence must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The difference between the maximum and minimum integers in the sequence must equal the square root of their sum.
